test_apply_func_that_appends_group_to_li: test groupby apply that appends each group to a list without copying
test_apply_index_date: test groupby apply with DatetimeIndex using date extraction for grouping
test_group_apply_once_per_group: test that groupby apply executes the function exactly once per group
test_apply_with_mixed_dtype: test groupby apply with mixed dtype columns and as_index parameter
test_apply_transform: test groupby apply producing identical results to transform operation
test_apply_function_returns_non_pandas_n: test groupby apply returning non-pandas types like lists, sets, tuples, dicts
test_apply_as_index_constant_lambda: test groupby apply returning constant values with as_index parameter
test_apply_with_timezones_aware: test groupby apply with timezone-aware and naive datetime columns
test_apply_function_with_indexing_return: test groupby apply with as_index=False returning mean per group
test_inconsistent_return_type: test groupby apply returning inconsistent types including None per group
test_apply_dropna_with_indexed_same: test groupby apply with dropna parameter on groups containing NaN
test_apply_empty_string_nan_coerce_bug: test groupby apply with empty strings and NaN values in grouping columns
test_apply_aggregating_timedelta_and_dat: test groupby apply aggregating timedelta and datetime columns together
test_apply_function_returns_numpy_array: test groupby apply returning numpy arrays from each group
test_apply_multikey_corner: test groupby apply with multiple lambda keys for grouping
test_apply_series_to_frame: test Series groupby apply returning a DataFrame per group
test_apply_str_with_args: test groupby apply passing string method name with positional and keyword args
test_builtins_apply: test groupby apply using Python builtins like max, min, sum as the function
test_groupby_apply_all_none: test groupby apply where the function returns None for all groups
test_groupby_apply_none_first: test groupby apply returning None from the first group only
